newsitem.title: PANAMA: Port conditions update - Panama - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Panama - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BALBOA, April 27 - The Panama Canal Commission issued following based on projected number of vessels waiting for canal transit, as result of reduced capacity at Miraflores Locks due to salvage operation to remove a sunken tug. The number of reservations allocated will be reduced.
All existing bookings will be honoured. However, the booking fee will be increased. The number of new bookings available day will be reduced until further notice.
